Tara: Quick question on flag scope precedence — if an org-level rollout is 100% but a model-level rollout is 0% for model X, what happens for a request to model X in project P/route R?
Kevin: Most-specific wins: model > route > project > org. So model-level 0% should override org's 100%.
Tara: Are we sure that's what flag-eval actually does? I glanced at flag-eval/evaluator.go and it looks like it merges maps then applies `lastWriteWins` order.
Sana: We had a historical debate: do we prefer 'most-specific wins' (by scope) or 'last configured wins' (by precedence). The design doc (internal) says scope-based. We should add an explicit unit test.
Leo: Example that caused confusion: (short repro in staging)
Kevin: ```
{
  "org": {"rollout_pct": 100},
  "project": {},
  "route": {"rollout_pct": 50},
  "model": {"rollout_pct": 0, "audience": ["acct:123"]}
}
```
Kevin: For a request from acct:456 to model X, model scope doesn't match audience — should we fall back to route (50%) or block because model has explicit rollout_pct 0?
Sana: Intended: audience is a guardrail only when present. If model has `audience` specified, it's a scoped-target; non-matching principals should fall back to less-specific rollout. But if model sets `block_non_audience: true` then block.
Tara: So we need three rules: 1) scope specificity determines which config is considered first; 2) if that config has audience and block flag -> block; 3) else if audience present and doesn't match -> evaluate next less-specific config.
Kevin: Yep. We should codify as algorithm in docs and add sample unit tests. Also want to support `inherit: false` on a scope to stop fallback (e.g., project with `inherit: false` should prevent org from applying).
Leo: That `inherit: false` is new — do we have it implemented?
Kevin: Not yet. It's in feature branch `flags/inherit-fix`. I'll open PR today and add tests + a migration note.
Tara: Can we add a short compatibility test in rollout e2e that verifies model overrides org?
Sana: I'll add an async test in the eval harness, then wire it into CI. PR: #789 (will link once open).
Tara: Also want a doc blurb for the Console: when showing 'Effective rollout', show which scope claimed the decision and why.
Kevin: Good idea — Console can show `source_scope` and `matched_audience`.
Deploy-bot: flag-eval lib published v2.4.1, deployment queued to staging :rocket:
Leo: :eyes: ping @Kevin once PR is up so eng-platform can review.
Kevin: will do. Thanks all.
